value: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in providing specialized services for railroad transportation, including servicing, routine repairing (except factory conversion, overhaul, or rebuilding of rolling stock), and maintaining rail cars; loading and unloading rail cars; and operating independent terminals.
Grain leveling and trimming in railroad cars
Loading and unloading services at rail terminals
Locomotive and rail car repair (except factory conversion, factory overhaul, factory rebuilding)
Maintenance of rights of way and structures, railway
